review.title: Transwell: five reference correspondences with distinct assay and stock identities
review.independence_basis: The whole current record, selected retained primary reporter and three-member assay passages, later primary reclassification passages, authoritative strain taxonomy XML, historical decision ledgers and complete participant guard were read before source preparation. Independent source review and actual M5 candidate/input review preceded application. Actual application, native history and eight scoped native commands used the same reviewed shared path as the completed Sorghum canary. This is a partial technical diagnostic, not a new full scientific review.
review.summary: Five separately preserved Transwell stock descriptors now carry native GTDB reference blocks and GROUNDED statuses. The two reporter strains remain distinct from the separate three-member metabolomics series. Original NCBI species/strain anchors, source names, qualified stock identity, historical notes, exact quotations, two graph observations, zero arrows and old history remain unchanged. The actual guarded M5 application, two native inline events, one sidecar and eight native commands are bound. Species reference totals and fractions do not identify study-stock genomes, resolve the SC11,368 versus SC11,378 conflict or establish selective inhibition mediation.
review.scope_description: Five taxonomy blocks and grounding statuses at indices 0-4; source-stock, assay, taxonomic-rank and reference-population boundaries; actual guarded application, native history and eight scoped technical checks. Existing scientific claims and limitations are preserved without a new approval judgment.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000091 follows the completed, independently verified Sorghum 348 canary using the same frozen c9bb M5 execution path. Records 395 and 398 remain unapplied. This saved assessment covers only Transwell 091.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Native validator success does not establish full scientific approval, fresh source-snippet certification, generated-product verification, aggregate QC completion or closure of earlier findings.

Primary coverage is selected actual Results, Table 1, reporter and metabolomics passages from retained PMID:29152587, selected reclassification body passages from PMID:33159606, and retained authoritative taxonomy XML. No fresh complete Methods, figure-pixel, supplement, raw-spectra, genome or current culture-stock audit was performed for this diagnostic.

Cv017 and Cv026 remain separate producer and recipient stocks. Their reporter assay is not the separate three-member series containing qualified SC11,378 (ATCC 31532), E264 and DC3000. The five taxonomy entries are not a single five-member experimental culture.

The 2017 source Table 1 says SC11,378 whereas the demonstration prose says SC11,368. Retain the explicitly qualified current identity and both source spellings. The later reclassification supports the ATCC 31532 parent lineage and CV026 species correspondence, but does not reconcile those conflicting stock numbers or independently authenticate the experimental stock.

Each of the three NCBI species 251747 descriptors maps to Chromobacterium subtsugae with total 25 reference genomes and fraction 1.0. NCBI strain 271848 for E264 maps to Burkholderia thailandensis with total 6/fraction 1.0; strain 223283 for DC3000 maps to Pseudomonas_E avellanae with total 2/fraction 1.0. No exact supporting numerator or experimental assembly identity is supplied or inferred.

Retain the original NCBI strain ranks and labels for E264/DC3000 and the source Pseudomonas syringae terminology. The GTDB suffix/name difference and native is_reclassified result do not establish a formal nomenclatural revision, a changed study organism or imported reference-genome functions.

Preserve the two graph observations and zero arrows. The 977 mass features are not 977 identified metabolites; bactobolin accumulation does not selectively prove inhibition mediation. The SC11 stock conflict, cultivation and new-antagonism research limits remain under issue 1467. Its original umbrella-roster description predates a retained partial repair and is not repeated as a new current defect.

Crosswalk SHA256 761d5537 identifies exact bytes with no established upstream release or chronology. Native mapping_source reflects file mtime, not release provenance. Local NCBI label/rank observations retain database identity/stat rather than a full database digest or certified release.

Source preparation used its recorded earlier revision, while actual M5 staging, application and eight native commands used frozen c9bb51a8b2a5591400dc8f170f043e59642116ce with Python 3.13.2. A named isolated M5 branch was created at that unchanged HEAD before application. The working tree contains the actual applied record; this is not a clean-HEAD aggregate execution.

All five statuses changed among five processed descriptors. Two native inline events and one native sidecar preserve old history. The participant guard retains biological mutation controls and the immutable historical census; exact successor admission must project only necessary historical mapping/hash values after authenticating the full bounded transition. Unrelated corpus thresholds must not be weakened.

Two initial outer SSH stage launches failed on hostname resolution before inner execution; the retained authorized network launch then completed actual staging. No failed execution is represented as a successful native gate. The original source-anchor failure and its additive exact-anchor correction under issue 2926 remain preserved.

Saved evidence, complete input checkpoints, public export and strict historical admission are separate persistence steps. Actual measured reference comparisons, generated products, final combined QC and scientific-finding dispositions remain outside this diagnostic.

evidence.locator: Retained Results reporter pairing, Table 1, separate three-member demonstration, mass-feature and bactobolin passages; exact source anchors bound in the source proof.
evidence.summary: Actual source passages distinguish Cv017/Cv026 from the separate SC11 stock/E264/DC3000 series. Table and prose conflict on SC11,378 versus SC11,368. These source contexts support bounded stock/assay identity, not direct GTDB placement or selective antagonism.

evidence.locator: Retained abstract/key points, phylogenetic Results and Discussion identifying ATCC 31532 and the CV026 biosensor lineage.
evidence.summary: The later primary source supports C. subtsugae for the parent lineage and CV026. Cv017 derivative identity and participation remain supported by the separate original Table 1; no current stock authentication or fresh genome analysis is claimed.

evidence.locator: Retained exact NCBI 251747 species, 271848 strain E264/ATCC 700388, and 223283 strain DC3000/ATCC BAA-871 authority rows.
evidence.summary: Original species and strain anchors remain explicit. Species-level GTDB results do not erase the existing strain identity, rank or qualified source metadata.

evidence.locator: Five selected occurrences, complete native_result/classify_status, local NCBI identity observations, lookup-row hashes and captured primary-source identities.
evidence.summary: Three separately preserved source stocks share a 25/fraction 1.0 C. subtsugae reference correspondence; E264 and DC3000 have exact-ID 6/fraction 1.0 and 2/fraction 1.0 results. Totals/fractions are reference observations without an explicit support numerator, experimental stock-genome identity or causal inference.

evidence.locator: Actual applied flag, c9bb execution revision, exact before/after, reviewed stage and source inputs, native writer hash; actual sidecar bound separately.
evidence.summary: The guarded M5 writer persisted d0185ba9 from 51bf55d5 after independent candidate review. Only five selected blocks/statuses and two native events changed. Stock metadata, source conflict, separate assays, graph, quotations and previous history remain intact.

evidence.summary: SC11 identity conflict and mechanistic/cultivation limits remain unresolved. The current record already distinguishes the reporter and three-member assays; the stale part of the issue description is not treated as a newly observed current defect.

evidence.summary: Current strain-specific participant and mutation predicates remain active. Later admission must verify current source/biology equality before projecting only historical mapping/hash expectations and must retain the original census without lowering unrelated requirements.

assessments.topic: Five distinct stocks across two separate assay contexts
assessments.summary: Source identity supports separately retained Cv017, Cv026, qualified SC11,378/ATCC 31532, E264 and DC3000, with species versus strain anchors preserved. The first two form the reporter pair; the latter three form a separate experimental series. The SC11,368/SC11,378 conflict is not repaired by reference grounding, and earlier scientific limitations remain.

assessments.topic: Five native correspondences with unchanged source and NCBI identities
assessments.summary: Exact-ID routes yield three distinct descriptor occurrences of C. subtsugae 25/fraction 1.0, E264 to B. thailandensis 6/fraction 1.0, and DC3000 to Pseudomonas_E avellanae 2/fraction 1.0. No supporting numerator, study assembly, formal nomenclature or functional transfer is inferred. Original rank/name/stock fields and unknown crosswalk-release provenance remain explicit.

assessments.topic: Actual bounded application, native history and eight scoped commands
assessments.summary: Actual before/after receipt, two native inline events, one new sidecar and all eight completed native checks bind frozen c9bb M5 execution. Five statuses changed; all prior biological/source content and history remain unchanged. Full saved input checkpoints, strict successor admission, measured source comparisons and final combined QC remain separately required.
